mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates growing demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a 3-month period indicates a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a 3-month period, it signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over a 6-month period, coupled with a simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both increase over 6 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a single month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over a 6-month period, coupled with a simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong economic growth and increased demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase over 6 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
